help.title: User Guide
help.hero_subtitle: Complete guide to managing your vehicle fleet. Learn how to use every module of the system step by step.
help.overview_p1: FleetCore is a corporate fleet management system designed to track vehicles, drivers, maintenance, expenses, and vehicle documents with deadlines in one place. It is built for fleet managers, administrators, and drivers at large enterprises.
help.overview_p2: The system consists of the following main modules:
help.overview_vehicles_desc: Registry of all vehicles with full specifications, status tracking, and photo gallery
help.overview_drivers_desc: Driver profiles, optional logins, one vehicle per driver, licences and documents with manager approval
help.overview_maintenance_desc: Schedule and track all service and repair work
help.overview_expenses_desc: Record and categorize all fleet-related costs, including fuel
help.overview_reports_desc: Analytics: TCO, fuel consumption, expense analysis, maintenance history
help.role_admin_desc: Full access, including users and the audit log. Approves driver document changes.
help.role_manager_desc: Manages vehicles, drivers and their vehicle assignment, maintenance, expenses, documents & deadlines and reports. Approves driver document changes. No access to users or the audit log.
help.role_driver_desc: Sees only their own driver profile and, if a vehicle is assigned, that vehicle. Proposes licence and document changes (a manager approves them), uploads files, and adds expenses and maintenance for the assigned vehicle.
help.role_viewer_desc: Read-only access to data, dashboards and reports. Driver document numbers are masked.
help.dashboard_p1: The dashboard is the home page that gives you a quick overview of the entire fleet. It loads automatically when you sign in. All data updates in real time. Drivers do not see the dashboard: they go straight to their own profile.
help.dashboard_widget_fleet_desc: Shows total vehicle count by status: Active, In Maintenance, Decommissioned
help.dashboard_widget_attention_desc: Alerts for overdue maintenance, expiring or expired vehicle documents, licenses, and medical certificates
help.dashboard_widget_expenses_desc: Chart showing expense breakdown by category for the last 6 months
help.dashboard_widget_maint_desc: Recent maintenance records and overall statistics
help.dashboard_widget_top_desc: Vehicles with the highest total expenses
help.howto_add: How to add a new record
help.vehicles_p1: The Vehicles section is the core registry of all fleet vehicles. Each vehicle has a detailed profile card with license plate, VIN, brand, model, year, status, and more.
help.vehicles_step_filter: Use the search bar (plate, VIN, brand, model) and the vehicle type and status filters to find a vehicle
help.vehicles_step_click: Click on any row to open the vehicle page. Edit and Delete are on that page
help.vehicles_add_step1: Click the "Add Vehicle" button at the top of the vehicle list
help.vehicles_add_step2: Choose a vehicle type, brand, model and configured department. Road vehicles require a plate; forklift internal IDs are generated automatically. VIN and manufacturing year are optional. Technical fields follow the selected type.
help.vehicles_add_step3: Click "Save" to create the vehicle record
help.vehicle_detail_desc: Each vehicle has a detail page with multiple tabs. Click any tab to see the related data:
help.drivers_p1: The Drivers section holds driver profiles with their licences and documents, and the vehicle assigned to each driver. A driver can also have a login, so they can sign in and manage their own documents.
help.drivers_alert_desc: The system computes the status of driver documents (valid, expiring soon, expired) from the end date and shows warnings on the dashboard. Documents without an end date and older entries never warn.
help.mileage_p1: Tractor units, vans and passenger cars track mileage. Enter an initial reading on Create or a new reading on Edit. Blank Edit readings keep the current value. Type changes preserve history.
help.mileage_step1: Open the vehicle detail page and switch to the "Mileage" tab
help.mileage_step2: The table shows all mileage entries with date, reading, delta, and source
help.mileage_step3: New readings are validated: the value must be greater than or equal to the previous entry. A lower mileage entered on a maintenance record needs an explicit confirmation and is stored as a correction.
help.mileage_note_desc: The delta column shows how many kilometers were driven between the current and the previous reading. This helps spot abnormal jumps.
help.maintenance_p1: The Maintenance section lets you plan, track, and complete all service and repair work for your fleet. Each record is linked to a specific vehicle. Managers can add, edit, complete and delete records; a driver with an assigned vehicle can add records for that vehicle.
help.maint_status_scheduled_desc: Work is planned but not started yet
help.maintenance_add_step1: Click "Add Maintenance" on the maintenance list page
help.maintenance_add_step2: Select the vehicle and fill in the type, title, scheduled date
help.maintenance_add_step3: Optionally add service provider, cost, and notes
help.expenses_p1: The Expenses section records all costs associated with your fleet. Every expense is linked to a vehicle and categorized for easy analysis. A driver with an assigned vehicle can add expenses for that vehicle.
help.expense_fuel_desc: When adding a fuel expense, additional fields appear: liters, price per liter, and mileage at refueling. This data is used in fuel consumption reports.
help.expense_add_step1: Click "Add Expense" on the expense list page
help.expense_add_step2: Select the vehicle, category, and enter the amount
help.expense_add_step3: For fuel expenses, fill in the liters and price per liter fields
help.documents_p1: Documents can be attached to vehicles, drivers, maintenance records, expenses and documents with deadlines. Supported formats include images (JPG, PNG), PDF, Word, and Excel files up to 10 MB.
help.documents_upload_step1: Open the detail page of a vehicle, driver, maintenance record, expense, or vehicle document
help.documents_upload_step2: Scroll to the Documents section and drag a file onto the upload area, or click to browse
help.documents_upload_step3: Select the document type and click Upload
help.documents_formats_desc: JPG, PNG, PDF, Word (.doc, .docx), Excel (.xls, .xlsx). Maximum file size: 10 MB.
help.reports_p1: The Reports section provides fleet analytics. Select a report, set the filters and view the results. Exports contain exactly what is shown on the page.
help.report_tco_desc: Total cost of ownership per vehicle: purchase price + all expenses
help.report_fuel_desc: Fuel per vehicle: liters, cost, number of refuels and consumption in L/100 km (tractor units, vans and passenger cars with at least two refuels with mileage)
help.report_expense_desc: Expense distribution by category with monthly trend charts
help.report_maint_desc: Maintenance history across the fleet with status, dates and cost; the total does not include cancelled work
help.reports_filters_desc: All reports have the same filters: vehicle (search by plate, brand or model), vehicle type (tractor units, trailers, vans, passenger cars, forklifts), and a start and end date. Maintenance history also filters by status; its dates apply to the service date (the completed date, or the scheduled date until the work is done). A vehicle outside the chosen type gives an empty report.
help.reports_export_desc: Use the green Export to Excel button on a report to download it as Excel (.xlsx). The file contains the same data as the page, with the filters you applied, and starts with the same summary figures; tables end with a totals row.
help.notifications_p1: The bell icon in the top bar shows in-app notifications. Open it to read them or mark them as read.
help.settings_p1: Users and the audit log are available to administrators only. Everyone can change their own profile and password.
help.settings_users_desc: Settings → Users lists all accounts. Create a user with “Add user”, change one with “Edit”.
help.settings_audit_desc: Every creation, change and deletion of vehicles, drivers, maintenance, expenses, documents, uploaded files, mileage readings and users is recorded automatically, together with sign-ins, sign-outs and report exports. Each entry shows who did it, when and from which IP address. Filter by start and end date (inclusive, in UTC), user, action or entity, and click “N fields” to see old and new values. The log is read-only, and document numbers are masked.
help.settings_profile_step1: Click your name in the top-right corner and select "Profile"
help.settings_profile_step2: Change your name or your password (the eye icon shows or hides what you type)
help.settings_lang_desc: Use the language icon to switch between Bulgarian and English. Your preference is saved automatically.
help.tip_dark_mode_desc: Click the moon icon in the top bar to switch to dark mode. The setting is saved in your browser.
help.tip_filters_desc: All list pages have filters. Combine search, status, and date filters to quickly find what you need.
help.tip_keyboard_desc: Click on any row in a table to open the detail page. Use the sidebar to jump between modules.
help.tip_export_desc: All reports can be exported to Excel (.xlsx), with the filters you applied and the report's summary, for further analysis in spreadsheets.

help.compliance_p1: The Documents & Deadlines section stores each vehicle's insurance policies, technical inspections and tachograph inspections together with their validity period.
help.compliance_applicability: Tractor units have all four types. Semi-trailers, vans and passenger cars have no tachograph. Forklifts have no documents in this section.
help.compliance_status_rule: Status is computed from the end date. "Expiring soon" means within {days} days. For each type only the entry with the latest end date is tracked; older entries are history.
help.compliance_add_step1: Click "Add document" on the list or on the vehicle's tab
help.compliance_add_step2: Search for the vehicle, choose the document type and enter the validity period
help.compliance_add_step3: Save, then attach the scanned document if needed
help.compliance_renew_p1: "Renew" creates a new entry for the same vehicle and type with new dates. The old entry stays in the history with its number and file. Use "Edit" only for corrections.

driver_doc.renew_hint: This creates a new entry; the current one stays in the history. Number, categories and notes are prefilled from the current entry — change them if they changed.
driver_doc.add_after_save: The ID card, driving licence and other documents are added in the “Licences & Documents” tab after saving.
driver_doc.attachment_after_save: You can attach the scanned document after saving.

error.driver_document_end_before_start: The end date must be on or after the start date
help.drivers_docs_desc: In each driver, the “Licences & Documents” tab tracks the ID card, driving licence, driver card, psychological test, professional competence and medical certificate. Each entry has a number, an issue date and a “valid until” date (leave empty for documents that do not expire). The status is computed from the end date; “Renew” creates a new entry and keeps the old one in the history. Scanned files are attached to the entry. When a driver changes their own documents, a manager approves the change first (see “Approval of driver changes” below).
maintenance.service_item_hint: Choose what is serviced so its next due is tracked separately (for example engine oil and differential oil).
maintenance.next_service_hint: Filled in by you, for example mileage + 60,000 km. The system warns when it is near or overdue.
maintenance.service_due_hint: The latest completed planned service for each item and when the next one is due. Older records never warn.

error.vehicle_not_assignable: Only trucks and cars (tractor units, vans, passenger cars) can be assigned to a driver. Trailers and forklifts cannot.
error.expense_driver_category: Insurance and inspection documents are added by a fleet manager. Add other expenses here.
error.vehicle_already_assigned: This vehicle already has a driver. Remove it from that driver first.
error.driver_has_vehicle: This driver already has a vehicle. A driver can have only one; remove the current one first.
driver.one_vehicle_hint: A driver can have only one vehicle. Remove the current one (×) to assign a different vehicle.
help.vehicles_driver_desc: A vehicle is assigned to a driver from the driver's page (Drivers → the driver → Assign vehicle), not from the vehicle. Only trucks and cars can be assigned: tractor units, vans and passenger cars. Trailers and forklifts cannot.
help.drivers_login_step1: Create the driver profile in Drivers (full name, phone, email, department)
help.drivers_login_step2: An administrator opens Settings → Users → Add user and chooses the role Driver
help.drivers_login_step3: Pick the driver profile. The full name and email are taken from the profile and cannot be changed there. If the profile has no email, enter one: it is saved to the profile as well
help.drivers_login_step4: Choose a username (it must be unique) and a password, then save
help.drivers_login_note: A driver login always belongs to a driver profile. Profiles that already have a login, or that are terminated, are not offered.
help.drivers_assign_step1: Open the driver and look at “Assigned vehicles”
help.drivers_assign_step2: Search for a vehicle in the field and click “Assign vehicle”
help.drivers_assign_note: A driver has one vehicle and a vehicle has one driver. Only trucks and cars that have no driver are offered. To change the vehicle, remove the current one (×) first. A terminated driver cannot be assigned a vehicle.
help.drivers_view_p1: A driver who signs in lands on their own profile and cannot open the dashboard, reports, other drivers or settings.
help.drivers_view_no_vehicle: Without an assigned vehicle: only their profile (General data, Uploaded documents, Licences & Documents), plus their account page, the guide and notifications.
help.drivers_view_vehicle: With an assigned vehicle: also Vehicles, Expenses, Maintenance and Documents & Deadlines, showing only that vehicle. They can add expenses and maintenance for it and upload files, but cannot edit or delete records, and insurance and inspection documents are added by a manager.
help.drivers_approval_step1: The driver adds, edits or renews a document in their Licences & Documents tab and clicks “Submit for approval”. Nothing changes yet and the request shows as “Waiting for approval”.
help.drivers_approval_step2: Managers are notified, and the Drivers list shows a banner with the number of changes waiting. It opens the page “Changes waiting for approval”.
help.drivers_approval_step3: Approve applies the change. “Ask to redo” sends it back to the driver with your note, so they can correct and resubmit it or delete it. Reject deletes it and the driver is not told.
help.drivers_approval_note: A driver can cancel their own waiting request. Uploading files does not need approval.
help.maintenance_service_desc: For a planned service you can choose what was serviced (engine oil, gearbox oil, differential oil, brake fluid, coolant) and when it is next due, by km and/or date. The latest completed service of each item is tracked: overdue and due-soon services appear on the Service due page, on the vehicle's Maintenance tab and on the dashboard. Trailers have no service items.
help.expenses_documents_note: Insurance, technical inspection and tachograph expenses (civil liability, CASCO, technical inspection, tachograph) also create or update the matching entry in Documents & Deadlines. These are added by managers.
help.documents_driver_note: Drivers can upload files to their own profile and document entries, and to the records of their assigned vehicle, without approval. They can delete files they uploaded themselves.
help.notif_type_approval: Managers: a driver submitted a document change to approve
help.notif_type_decision: Drivers: a document change was approved or sent back for changes
help.notifications_warnings_desc: Upcoming and overdue maintenance, due services and expiring vehicle or driver documents are shown as coloured badges, in “Attention needed” on the dashboard and on the Service due page. They are checked every day at 08:00 but are not sent as messages.
help.settings_users_step2: Choose the role first. For a driver, pick the driver profile (create it in Drivers first); the name and email come from the profile
help.settings_users_step3: Enter a username (unique, it can be changed later), the language and a password (use the eye icon to check it)
help.settings_users_step4: “Edit” changes the details, the role, the language, the active status and can set a new password. A deactivated user cannot sign in. You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.
help.tip_colors_desc: Green is active, completed or valid. Yellow is a warning or work in progress. Red is a problem or expired. Blue is information and gray is neutral.
help.driver_hero_subtitle: What you can do in FleetCore as a driver, step by step.
help.driver_profile_p1: When you sign in you land on your driver profile. It has three tabs: General data (your details), Uploaded documents (your files) and Licences & Documents (your ID card, driving licence, driver card, psychological test, professional competence and medical certificate).
help.driver_profile_p2: To change your name, phone, email or other details, ask a fleet manager.
help.driver_docs_p1: Each document shows a status: valid, expiring soon, expired or no expiry. You can add a document, edit it or renew it, but a fleet manager approves every change before it takes effect.
help.driver_docs_step1: Open the Licences & Documents tab of your profile
help.driver_docs_step2: Click “Add document” for a missing one, “Renew” for a new validity period, or open the document and click “Edit” to correct it
help.driver_docs_step3: Fill in the number, categories and dates, then click “Submit for approval”
help.driver_docs_step4: Your request shows as “Waiting for approval”. Until it is approved, your documents stay exactly as they were
help.driver_docs_outcome_approved: Approved: the change appears in your documents and you get a notification
help.driver_docs_outcome_redo: Changes requested: the manager's note is shown on your request. Click “Edit and resubmit” to correct it, or “Delete request” to drop it
help.driver_docs_outcome_rejected: Rejected: the request is removed and you are not shown it again
help.driver_docs_note: You can have one waiting request per document type. You can cancel a waiting request yourself.
help.driver_files_p1: Scanned documents and photos need no approval. Upload them in the Uploaded documents tab of your profile, or on one of your document entries.
help.driver_files_step1: Drag a file onto the upload area, or click it to browse
help.driver_files_step2: Choose the document type and click Upload
help.driver_files_note: Accepted: JPG, PNG, PDF, Word and Excel files up to 10 MB. You can delete a file you uploaded yourself (hover over it and click the red ×).
help.driver_vehicle_p1: A fleet manager assigns your vehicle. You see only that vehicle, never other vehicles or drivers.
help.driver_vehicle_see: Vehicles, Expenses, Maintenance and Documents & Deadlines show only your vehicle, read-only
help.driver_vehicle_expense: Expenses → “Add expense”: your vehicle is already selected. Choose the category, amount and date (for fuel add the liters and price). Insurance and inspection documents are added by a manager
help.driver_vehicle_maintenance: Maintenance → “Add maintenance”: describe the service or repair, the date and, if you know it, the cost and mileage
help.driver_vehicle_upload: Open your vehicle, an expense or a maintenance record and upload receipts, invoices or photos there
help.driver_vehicle_note: You cannot edit or delete expenses and maintenance records once they are saved; ask a fleet manager if something is wrong.
help.driver_vehicle_none: No vehicle is assigned to you yet. When a fleet manager assigns one, the sections Vehicles, Expenses, Maintenance and Documents & Deadlines appear in the menu, and this guide explains how to use them.
help.driver_account_bell: The bell icon shows notifications, for example when your document change is approved or sent back for changes
help.driver_account_password: Your name in the top right corner → Profile: change your password (the eye icon shows what you type)
help.driver_account_language: The language icon switches between Bulgarian and English; the moon icon switches dark mode

error.notification_repeat_invalid: The repeat interval must be a whole number of days between 1 and {days}

error.notification_chat_id_required: Enter your Telegram chat ID to receive Telegram messages
notifications.rules_intro: For each document type: when reminders go out, over which channels, and to whom. Until a rule is saved, nothing is sent.
notifications.rules_readonly: Only an administrator can change rules.
notifications.milestones_hint: Press Enter or comma to add, for example 30, 15, 10
notifications.stop_after_hint: Leave empty to continue until renewed or stopped
notifications.send_time_hint: Leave empty to use the default send time
notifications.not_configured: Not set up yet: nothing is sent
notifications.warn_no_recipients: No recipients: nothing will be sent
notifications.warn_no_channel: No channel selected: nothing will be sent
notifications.apply_confirm: Copy this rule to the other documents of this group?
notifications.settings_intro: Reminders go out once a day at the send time below. A rule can use its own time.
notifications.smtp_missing: Email (SMTP) is not configured: emails cannot be sent
notifications.telegram_missing: The Telegram bot is not configured: Telegram messages cannot be sent
notifications.credentials_note: Credentials come from the server configuration and are never shown here.
notifications.channels_intro: How you receive reminders when a rule includes you.
notifications.chat_id_hint: Start a chat with the company bot, then enter your numeric chat ID
reminder.subject: {document}: {subject} — {when}
reminder.title_expiring: A document is about to expire
reminder.stop_hint: You can stop these reminders on that page.
reminder.test_body: This is a test message from FleetCore. Your {channel} channel works.
notifications.test_failed: The test message could not be sent. Check the settings and try again.
notifications.test_not_configured: This channel is not configured on the server.
notifications.test_no_target: Save your email or Telegram chat ID first.
notifications.stop_hint: Stopping applies to everyone and every channel. It resets when the document is renewed or its end date changes.
notifications.next_off: No reminders are sent for this document type
notifications.test_hint: Sends a short test message to the address or chat saved above.
error.password_is_username: The password must not be the same as the username.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.csrf: Security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
error.file_content_mismatch: The file content does not match its type. Upload a real PDF, image or Office document.
notifications.recipient_telegram_hint: Telegram messages go to these chats (for example the company group). Everyone in a Telegram group sees them; nobody needs to set up Telegram personally.
toll_import.title: Toll import
toll_import.intro: Import Shell Card toll transactions as toll expenses: one expense per vehicle and day.
toll_import.upload_hint: In the Shell Card portal export the "Priced Transaction" report as CSV. You can upload overlapping periods: transactions already imported are skipped, only new ones are added. You see a preview before anything is saved.
toll_import.waiting_hint: These transactions could not be imported yet. Fix the cause (for example add the missing vehicle), then upload the same file again: only these will be added.
toll_import.preview_message: Nothing has been saved yet. Check the numbers below, then import.
toll_import.preview_nothing_new: Nothing new to import: every row of this file was already imported. Nothing has been saved.
toll_import.applied_message: Imported transactions: {rows} ({amount}). New expenses: {created}, updated expenses: {updated}.
toll_import.expenses_line: {vehicles} vehicles · {created} new toll expenses · {updated} existing expenses grow
toll_import.problems_hint: Each of these blocks only itself; everything else was imported. After fixing the cause, upload the file again.
toll_import.notify_title: Toll import: some lines were not imported
toll_import.notify_message_plates: {count} lines of {filename} were not imported. Vehicles missing in FleetCore: {plates}.
toll_import.reason.bad_amount: Amount not recognised or more than 2 decimals
toll_import.reason.refund: Refund or negative amount (not supported yet)
toll_import.reason.conflict_in_file: Same transaction ID twice in the file with different data
toll_import.reason.changed: Already imported with a different vehicle, date or amount
toll_import.reason.ambiguous_vehicle: Plate matches more than one vehicle
toll_import.reason.not_applicable: Tolls do not apply to this vehicle type
error.toll_import_encoding: The file could not be read. Upload the CSV exactly as exported from the Shell portal.
error.toll_import_wrong_report: This is the "Toll Transaction" report. Upload the "Priced Transaction" CSV instead.
error.toll_import_columns: This is not a Shell Priced Transaction export. Missing columns: {columns}
error.toll_import_too_many_rows: The file has more than {limit} lines. Export a shorter period.
error.toll_import_conflict: Another import added some of these transactions at the same time. Upload the file again.
error.toll_import_excel: This is an Excel file. Upload the CSV export of the Priced Transaction report instead.
toll_import.drop_hint: CSV only, max 10 MB — the Shell Card "Priced Transaction" report
toll_import.invoiced_hint: These transactions are already imported and now have an invoice. Importing saves the invoice number on them; amounts do not change.
toll_import.invoiced_hint_applied: The invoice number was saved on these already imported transactions; amounts did not change.
